name: ember-core
title: EmberCore
description: background: 3D ash filament sphere with inner ember glow, vortex stir, shockwave strike and hold-to-charge burst (WebGL2, still under reduced motion)

item.name: ember-core
item.summary: background: 3D ash filament sphere with inner ember glow, vortex stir, shockwave strike and hold-to-charge burst (WebGL2, still under reduced motion)

useWhen: Flagship hero backgrounds needing a 3D interactive ember and ash sphere that never traps page scroll
Standalone interactive showcases where visitors can spin, zoom, stir, strike and charge the core
Dark-stage brand surfaces pairing headline typography with a tactile real-time WebGL focal point
avoidWhen: Dense data tables or long-form reading sections where a 3D focal point distracts from copy
Pages already running another WebGL background in the same viewport (one signature moment per screen)
Surfaces without a dark ground or contrast backing behind foreground text

alternatives.name: particle-field
alternatives.when: When a lighter field of discrete depth points fits better than a 3D filament sphere

alternatives.name: lantern-sky
alternatives.when: When a calm 2D canvas background of rising lanterns is preferred over WebGL2

tiers.0: CSS radial-gradient poster on dark obsidian ground; under prefers-reduced-motion on a WebGL2 browser, renders one still WebGL frame with 0 loop frames
tiers.1: CSS radial-gradient poster only (coarse pointer with low-end hardware hints)
tiers.2: WebGL2 at DPR <= 1.5 with 2,200 strands x 48 steps and 1,100 inner glow points; bloom falls back automatically if the frame budget fails
tiers.3: WebGL2 at DPR <= 2.0 with 4,600 strands x 62 steps, 2,000 inner glow points and 2-pass Gaussian bloom

reducedMotion.description: Renders one still frame of the 3D ember cloud with no animation loop; activating Strike shows one flared frame and returns to the still frame.

input.pointer: Hover stirs a local vortex and lights a pointer flame; drag spins the sphere on a world-axis quaternion with inertia; click (< 280 ms, < 6 px) fires a strike flare and shockwave ring; hold (>= 280 ms) charges and pulls the cloud inward, releasing into an outward burst; wheel zooms in 'full' mode (never in 'hero' mode).
input.touch: In 'hero' mode, touch-action is pan-y so vertical swipes scroll the page normally; only horizontal touch drags spin the sphere and hold-to-charge is disabled on touch. In 'full' mode, single-finger drag spins, two-finger pinch zooms, tap strikes and hold charges.
input.keyboard: In 'hero' mode, Tab reaches the real Strike button. In 'full' mode, the canvas has tabIndex=0 (arrow keys spin, Space or Enter strikes or charges when held, + and - zoom, P pauses) and Tab reaches the Controls, Pause and Strike buttons plus native sliders and palette chips.

a11y.notes: In 'hero' mode (the default), the canvas is aria-hidden and a real <button>Strike</button> is provided alongside any children. In 'full' mode, the canvas is focusable with an aria-label listing all gestures, accompanied by native range inputs, toggle buttons and a polite status live region.

props.name: interactive
props.effect: Selects the interaction mode. 'hero' is page-safe (no wheel zoom, touch-action: pan-y, decorative canvas, real Strike button); 'full' adds focusable canvas keyboard controls, wheel/pinch zoom and the Controls panel; 'none' disables pointer and touch handlers.

props.name: density
props.effect: Fraction of ash filaments and inner glow points drawn (0.2 to 1).

props.name: bloom
props.effect: Enables the 2-pass Gaussian bloom (strength 0.75, radius 0.6, threshold 0.18). Falls back automatically on Tier 2 if the frame budget fails.

props.name: sound
props.effect: Enables synthesized WebAudio crackle and low thump on user gestures (never plays before a user gesture; no audio files).

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the ash, ember, hot core and inner glow (DESIGN.md A8). 'custom' reads --fb-heat-0..4 via resolveCssColor.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: stops idle rotation and auto-strikes while allowing a visitor's direct gesture to play out and settle.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier (0 to 3).

props.name: offsetX
props.effect: Horizontal camera framing offset in world units (for example -0.32 to place the sphere slightly right of centre on wide screens).

props.name: nonce
props.effect: Optional CSP nonce forwarded to the scoped <style> element.

props.name: className
props.effect: Additional CSS classes on the root <div>.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root <div>, merged after palette variables.

props.name: children
props.effect: Optional foreground content layered above the ember cloud.

mistakes: Use interactive="hero" (the default) when placing EmberCore at the top of a scrollable page so wheel events and vertical touch swipes never trap scrolling.
Use interactive="full" only for dedicated interactive stages where wheel and pinch zoom are intended.
Do not place a second WebGL background in the same viewport; EmberCore acquires a glBudget lease while visible.
Keep foreground text in high-contrast light ink (#E9E5DF) with a dark backing over the glowing core so WCAG 4.5:1 contrast holds even during a strike flare.
verify: Confirm the CSS poster renders in server HTML before hydration with zero layout shift (CLS <= 0.01).
Confirm that in interactive="hero" mode, mouse wheel and vertical touch swipes scroll the page normally.
Confirm that under prefers-reduced-motion, one still frame is drawn with 0 ongoing animation frames.

notices: Includes 3D Simplex Noise from stegu/webgl-noise (MIT Copyright 2011 Ashima Arts, Stefan Gustavson).
